title: Non-decreasing Subsequences
goal: List all distinct nondecreasing subsequences of length at least two.
strategy: Backtracking preserves source order and permits equal values. A fresh used-value set at each recursion depth prevents duplicate choices at that depth without blocking equal values later in a subsequence.

phasePurposes.start: List all distinct nondecreasing subsequences of length at least two.

phasePurposes.done: List all distinct nondecreasing subsequences of length at least two.

edgeCases: Equal values may extend a nondecreasing subsequence
Strictly decreasing values have no length-two result
A singleton cannot produce a qualifying subsequence
